method: Mapped LC_SEGMENT_64 bytes; compared complete cached machine code and decoded original bytes with Capstone. Re-read 29 original feature entries/descriptors/vtables and 3 message arrays. Never execute original code. Pointer decoding only for checked local non-bind rebases.

scope.entry_flow: Initial 1D01; updates 1D05/1D06 and full transaction lifecycle delegated to chapter16
scope.warning: Recognized/registered message IDs are not identical to per-feature validated declarations. info+c0/c8 are accounted IDs: both accept and reject write them.

branches.input: 1D01 outer field has global registered handler
branches.when_true: Invoke handler, then inspect returned bit0
branches.when_false: Add ordinary field rejection reason1 and return1
branches.side_effect: Unknown field cannot add required-success membership
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:489-500 logs unregistered fields and continues
branches.open: Ordinary rejection serialization/platform authorization lifecycle in chapters12/16/18

branches.input: Registered handler return bit0=1
branches.when_true: Return0 after required-success bookkeeping
branches.when_false: Return1, no new required-success membership
branches.side_effect: Any prior field parsing effects remain until lifecycle cleanup
branches.current_source: IapIdentifyInfo.kt:13-41 parses selected fields atomically as a local object
branches.open: Other feature field callback internals not all audited

branches.input: Iterator next-param error flag ==1 / next pointer exists / saved callback return
branches.when_true: Error flag1 overrides with -1; otherwise next exists and callback0 continues
branches.when_false: No next or callback nonzero returns saved callback result
branches.side_effect: Even last unknown field returns nonzero; no-first-param returns0
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:494 ordered IDs converted to present set, no callback-result iterator
branches.open: Full low-level malformed first/next TLV framing audit outside this chapter

branches.input: ForEach result equals0
branches.when_true: Required-success and transport checks; only those passing reach checkAll
branches.when_false: Bypass checkAll, enter rejection authorization route
branches.side_effect: Unknown at beginning/middle/end blocks accept route; field order only alters preceding parse effects
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:502-519 may accept unknown outer field
branches.open: Authorization false may suppress actual wire 1D03

branches.input: Session/info nonnull; identified feature set +70 already exists
branches.when_true: Existing +70 cleared
branches.when_false: Null inputs return1; absent +70 created
branches.side_effect: No c0/c8 clear visible in this function
branches.current_source: No equivalent feature result set
branches.open: Full fresh/update info allocation and cleanup delegated lifecycle

branches.input: Registered descriptor vtable and validator present
branches.when_true: Call validator(session,info), OR status, continue all entries
branches.when_false: Null vtable skipped; missing validator logged only; null table/count0 local status0
branches.side_effect: No short circuit on earlier feature failure
branches.current_source: No registry-wide feature validator loop
branches.open: Only features22/26 bodies deep-audited; missing callback not proof feature available

branches.input: 12-byte descriptor direction and required bit with declaration membership
branches.when_true: Direction1 consults field7; member contributes anyPresent and required satisfaction
branches.when_false: Other direction consults field6; absent required makes allRequired false
branches.side_effect: n0 gives any0/allRequired1; no acceptance mutation
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.declarationPairComplete checks only two chosen pairs
branches.open: Only decoded descriptors with direction0/1 required0/1 are meaningful protocol cases

branches.input: Any group message declared in correct direction
branches.when_true: Present entries accepted/accounted; missing required rejected reason2; return2 if incomplete
branches.when_false: Return0 without message accounting or feature request
branches.side_effect: Present optional entry alone can activate required checks
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:517 accepts some one-sided groups then sendOptional skips them
branches.open: Completely absent group is not local rejection; unrelated global validators may still fail

branches.input: Direction0 or1
branches.when_true: acceptMsgID and rejectMsgID both write c0/c8 respectively; reject also appends rejection metadata
branches.when_false: Invalid direction returns without normal mutation
branches.side_effect: c0/c8 mean accounted, not unconditionally allowed
branches.current_source: CapabilityRegistry stores raw declared sets; no accounted/rejected separation
branches.open: CF allocation/type guarantees not executed

branches.input: Declared ID missing in matching accounted set after validators
branches.when_true: rejectMsgID reason1 in that direction; local result becomes1
branches.when_false: No generic additional rejection
branches.side_effect: All unique declared IDs enumerated, including wrong-direction known IDs; accepted/rejected feature IDs are already accounted
branches.current_source: IapIdentifyInfo accepts any even-framed 16-bit IDs; Bootstrap does no global ownership check
branches.open: Other feature validators may recognize specific IDs; do not invent complete supported-ID list

branches.input: Info valid and list byte count even
branches.when_true: BE16 decode into new CFSet; empty valid; duplicates collapse; replace previous directional set
branches.when_false: Null info returns1; odd count rejects field6/7 reason7, returns0x16, retains old set
branches.side_effect: Repeated valid outer list replaces not unions
branches.current_source: Wire.kt:8-11 rejects repeated outer6/7; list duplicates later dedup into sets
branches.open: CFSet allocation failure and full parser buffer preconditions

branches.input: Valid direction, messageID==0x00ff, reason==1
branches.when_true: Valid direction sets b8/b9; non-sentinel reason1 appends 2 BE bytes
branches.when_false: Sentinel0x00ff or reason!=1 appends no ID bytes, diagnostic only
branches.side_effect: Missing required reason2 can produce empty rejection-list TLV; helper has no universal dedup
branches.current_source: Bootstrap catches generic failures as empty1D03 or ordinary parameter TLV
branches.open: Caller universe of sentinel not completely audited; do not call0x00ff permitted

branches.input: featureStatus OR listStatus !=0
branches.when_true: Finalize rejection field6 then7
branches.when_false: Skip directional rejection finalizers
branches.side_effect: checkMsgIDList still runs after nonzero featureStatus
branches.current_source: No combined status/finalization pipeline
branches.open: No transactional rollback inferred from this local function

branches.input: Direction flag exactly1 AND corresponding outer6/7 count nonzero
branches.when_true: Emit outer6/7 TLV containing accumulated raw BE16 list, possibly empty
branches.when_false: No directional list TLV emitted
branches.side_effect: Length narrowed to16 bits; local reason not serialized; no repeat-finalization guard here
branches.current_source: Only ordinary field4-byte rejection TLV emitter currently used here
branches.open: Message builder capacity/error/oversized CFData behavior

branches.input: 4300 in field7 AND4301 in field6 after group validation
branches.when_true: Create feature26; mark identified
branches.when_false: Neither gives no feature; partial returns2 before creation
branches.side_effect: Registry feature26 start pointer NULL
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:413 waits for same pair only after already accepting1D01
branches.open: Platform availability event producer not fully followed

branches.input: DeviceWiFi group5700/5701 result0, then AccessoryWiFi group5702/5703 result0
branches.when_true: If either group present, create/mark feature22 and save two presence flags
branches.when_false: First failure returns early without checking second group; second failure prevents marking
branches.side_effect: Global validators still continue; generic list checker can reject second group's unaccounted declarations after first failure
branches.current_source: Bootstrap pairs5702/5703 only; no preaccept WiFi feature22 group lattice
branches.open: Other WiFi feature consumers/provider policy

branches.input: Authorization nonzero AND check status0 AND1D02 send return bit0
branches.when_true: state2 then submit1D02 then state6
branches.when_false: Authorization0 returns; status nonzero rejects; failed send leaves no state6 from this path
branches.side_effect: Static local send success is not peer receipt
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:518-519 sends then marks ACCEPTED; no equivalent platform authorization
branches.open: Asynchronous cancellation/stale pointer behavior in lifecycle chapter

branches.input: Pending rejection pointer exists and send returns nonzero
branches.when_true: Clear pending pointers, set state3, run rejection handler
branches.when_false: Send0 skips state3 but still calls rejection handler; null pending pointer sets state3 without send
branches.side_effect: Cannot equate state3 alone with observed wire1D03
branches.current_source: Bootstrap catch sends1D03 then throws
branches.open: Retry/cleanup details in chapter16

branches.input: Identification reached6; authentication state0 or2
branches.when_true: auth0 starts bootstrap feature0; auth2 calls authAndIDComplete then startFeaturesFromDevice(session,0)
branches.when_false: Other auth state no ordinary feature-start branch here
branches.side_effect: Feature startup not implied by raw1D02 bytes alone
branches.current_source: PeerNegotiationController.ready gates Bootstrap.sendOptional
branches.open: Complete auth-first event trigger and platform side effects not fully restudied

branches.input: Descriptor flag matches start group; ordinary feature isIdentified
branches.when_true: Requires ident state6 and+70 membership, then nonnull starter called
branches.when_false: Skip nonmatching/unidentified/no-starter
branches.side_effect: Batch starter returns0 regardless individual callback returns; feature26 has no starter
branches.current_source: No registered feature starters; fixed optional sequence
branches.open: Individual starter implementations other than22 not audited

branches.input: Single-feature flag bit0 or successful isIdentified check and starter exists
branches.when_true: Call starter
branches.when_false: Skip starter
branches.side_effect: Function returns0 on either path; not a startup success indicator
branches.current_source: No direct analog
branches.open: Do not extrapolate flag meanings beyond observed registration

branches.input: Session and feature22 exist; accessory group5702/5703 allRequired
branches.when_true: Build parameterless5702 then outgoing send gate
branches.when_false: No request from this path
branches.side_effect: feature22 may exist for only5700/5701 so existence alone is insufficient
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:409-412 uses matching pair then sends5702
branches.open: Provider/handoff timing is independent

branches.input: Valid session/dictionary and at least one availability object pointer
branches.when_true: Build4300 with only present groups/optional identifiers then normal outgoing gate
branches.side_effect: CFBoolean false is still a nonnull pointer; not a truth-value gate
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.kt:414 hardcodes wireless=true plus phoneMac
branches.open: Real platform dictionary producer/value validity/generation policy

branches.input: Ordinary outgoing4300/5702 or incoming4301/5703: auth2, ident6, current info, matching declared membership
branches.when_true: Pass corresponding direction gate
branches.when_false: Fail gate
branches.side_effect: Uses6/7, not c0/c8; bootstrap exceptions have separate logic
branches.current_source: Bootstrap.inboundAllowed and pair-checks partly match, but acceptance validators differ
branches.open: Handler registration, full session dispatch and wire delivery remain separate gates
